tools.name: binary_cube_describe_strengthening_strategy_campaign
tools.description: Describe the corpus-wide comparison of baseline Cube, subcube fan-out, and reversible data-dependent chaining, including payload families, metrics, and ranking limits.

tools.name: binary_cube_run_strengthening_strategy_campaign
tools.description: Run all three strengthening strategies across the authoritative representative payload corpus and return per-family plus aggregate exact-recovery, diffusion, expansion, and runtime-local evidence.

families.description: Optional custom corpus. Omit to use the authoritative seven-family acceptance corpus.

tools.outputDescription: Corpus-wide report with per-family evidence, aggregate strategy metrics, errors, round-trip failures, and a clearly bounded descriptive ordering that is not a security or promotion ranking.
